organism: Mycobacterium marinum M (RefSeq GCF_000018345.1; KEGG organism mmi, T00694)
description: 28 curated reactions and named proteins in 8 subsystems. Each is linked to M. marinum M genes only through KEGG EC or KO links and summarised with DESeq2 statistics. Not a genome-scale model; no flux balance analysis or flux predictions; no gene-protein-reaction logic is asserted. The file name is historical; the content is not SBML.

gene_identifier_bridge.method: KEGG mmi ids are original Sanger locus tags (MMAR_xxxx); DESeq2 ids are RefSeq PGAP locus tags (MMAR_RSxxxxx). Joined through the RefSeq GBFF /old_locus_tag qualifier; each pair checked by KEGG position (list/mmi) vs RefSeq gene coordinates.

definitions.reaction_genes: Union of mmi genes returned by KEGG link/mmi/<query> for the reaction's EC (preferred) or KO queries. No gene is added by hand.
definitions.tested_gene: Gene present in the contrast's DESeq2 table with non-missing padj.
definitions.deg: significant == 'YES' in the DESeq2 table (BH-adjusted Wald p < 0.05).
definitions.reaction_lead_gene: Tested gene with the smallest padj (ties: smaller pvalue, then gene id); reported with its padj and apeglm-shrunken log2FC.
definitions.median_log2fc_shrunk: Median of log2FoldChange_shrunk (apeglm) over the tested genes.
definitions.subsystem_genes: De-duplicated union of the subsystem's reaction genes.
definitions.hypergeom_p: One-sided hypergeometric P(X >= n_deg), X ~ Hypergeom(N = tested genes in the contrast, K = DEGs in the contrast, n = subsystem tested genes).
definitions.bh_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the subsystems within each contrast.
definitions.removed_metrics: The earlier Subsystem Perturbation Index, the mean-of-simulators log2FC with +/-0.5 direction calls, and the 'predominant flux shift' labels are removed.

subsystem_renames.reason: KEGG has no mmi gene in the glycopeptidolipid KOs (mps1 K16228, mps2 K16229), so both GPL reactions are dropped; only MurA remains.
The two reactions are ornithine carbamoyltransferase (arginine biosynthesis) and acetolactate synthase (valine/leucine/isoleucine); neither is a polyamine reaction.
The ESX KOs group the paralogues of every ESX locus, so these gene sets are not specific to the ESX-1 virulence system.

merged_reactions.reason: The two old entries (subunits C and D) are one reaction, EC 7.1.1.2; merged.

dropped_reactions.reason: No mmi gene linked to ko:K16228. Old EC 6.3.2.- is incomplete, so the entry is mapped by the mps1 KO (K16228).
No mmi gene linked to ko:K16229. Old EC 6.3.2.- is incomplete, so the entry is mapped by the mps2 KO (K16229).
Old EC 1.5.-.- is incomplete and the old locus has no KEGG KO, so KEGG offers no reaction or ortholog group to map.
